FluidSynth v2.6.2 (https://github.com/FluidSynth/fluidsynth, tag v2.6.2,
commit c3b244ddfd094489a5490beee013c621a504adf2), with its git submodules gcem and signalsmith-audio-basics
checked out at the commits that tag pins. The test/manual submodule (103 MB
of test data) is left out - it is only used by FluidSynth's own manual tests.

License: LGPL-2.1 (see LICENSE). FluidSynthPlayer.clap links it statically;
the complete corresponding source is this directory, so the plugin can be
rebuilt/relinked against a modified FluidSynth (LGPL section 6).
